sources: A Curio Class game, made outside this repository and brought in 2026-11-23 as a single file with no build (first called Chronia, renamed Time Tides 2026-11-23). source/chronia-atlas.html is that file untouched; src.html is the game with our changes, bundled into time-tides.html.

Era borders and place names look like the historical-basemaps world maps (GPL-3.0); coastlines, rivers and lakes look like Natural Earth (public domain). Neither is credited in the original file; license and credit await Cory's call.

Era stories, story arcs and 191 short overviews were written for the game; 1,513 encyclopedia summaries in the original file were left out of the live copy (unmatched entries and an unrecorded CC BY-SA source)
No image, sound or font files: the original's web fonts were swapped for fonts already on the device
